modern: Another may be more expert in throwing his opponent; but he is not more sociable, nor more modest, nor better disciplined to meet all that happens, nor more considerate towards the faults of his neighbours.
original: Another may be more expert in casting his opponent; but he is not more social, nor more modest, nor better disciplined to meet all that happens, nor more considerate with respect to the faults of his neighbors.
notification: Another may be more expert in throwing his opponent…
notification_original: Another may be more expert in casting his opponent…

explained.summary: Someone else may be better than you at wrestling, but that doesn’t make them more sociable, more modest, more ready for whatever life brings, or more patient with their neighbours’ faults. Marcus is telling himself that those are the contests worth winning.
explained.today: A colleague may be sharper at presentations or a friend fitter on the bike. That’s fine. Whether you’re kinder, steadier and more forgiving is the comparison that actually matters.
